caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a textured blue surface that mimics the appearance of tree bark. The pitcher has a handle shaped like a tree branch, rendered in an off-white color with subtle shading to suggest depth and dimension. The body of the pitcher is decorated with raised, winding vines and leaves, also in an off-white or light tan color, which contrast against the bright blue background. The rim of the pitcher and some of the base areas are highlighted with the same off-white coloring. The pitcher is positioned against a plain, light beige background. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
